lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the velvet street
Electric pulses beneath my feet
The city breathes in neon blue
Chasing dreams that feel brand new
[Pre-Chorus]
Gravity is pulling me away
The stars begin their silent play
[Chorus]
Lost in a galaxy of light
Dancing through the velvet night
Everything is glowing, wild and wide
Ride the wave of the rising tide
[Verse]
Silver mirrors in the morning haze
Lost within a golden maze
The skyline glows like a crown
Where the heavy world slows down
[Pre-Chorus]
Gravity is pulling me away
The stars begin their silent play
[Chorus]
Lost in a galaxy of light
Dancing through the velvet night
Everything is glowing, wild and wide

[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Fading out into the deep
Promises that the heavens keep
[Chorus]
Lost in a galaxy of light
Dancing through the velvet night
Everything is glowing, wild and wide
Ride the wave of the rising tide
[Outro]
